content.title: Banking: M&A activity will see 'very rapid' boost in 2026
content.description:
Earnings season is kicking off for big banks — JPMorgan Chase (JPM), Bank of America (BAC), Citigroup (C), Morgan Stanley (MS), Wells Fargo (WFC), Goldman Sachs (GS) — throughout next week. Major US bank stocks notably ended 2025 at new record highs.

Mendon Capital senior portfolio manager Anton Schutz explains how deregulation and M&A activity could present a promising environment for the banking sector.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.
